survey: A blue arched wooden door in a carved orange wooden frame, set into a cream plaster wall. Frame: a round arch on two upright posts, each standing on a square plinth block that rests on the stone threshold. Door: one arched leaf that fills the opening. It has an upper panel area and a lower panel of vertical boards, and it faces the camera straight on. Two brass hinges sit on the left edge between the door and the frame. A brass knob with a keyhole plate below it sits on the right edge, opposite the hinges, so the door would swing open normally. A round leafy wreath with pink, white and yellow flowers and an orange bow hangs centered on the upper panel, flat against the door. Ivy vines grow from the wall over the arch and down both sides of the frame. The threshold is a row of paving stones under the door and plinths.
